Derived from the original public env_audio/1_AUDIO.wav, first 120 seconds.
Publisher archive env_audio.zip MD5: 8c042dc817f459e80ac2491ffc8dd1cd.
No audio or artificial signal was generated for this fixture.

The standard 24 kHz float32 intake representation was transformed with the
production 0.5-second Hann spectrum / 0.125-second hop and production local
background/log-frequency normalization. The NPZ stores the first 64 frequency
rows and 64 time columns of the low-band and high-band images. Reproduce the
full images with scripts/benchmark_real_curved_dp.py prepare, then take those
submatrices. These are software recurrence checks, not source identities or
aircraft detection/localization accuracy evidence.
